defects.stage: post-compute proof audit after the first complete pass
defects.symptom: The 135-assertion pass used one generic fiber ACCEPT rather than separately naming A- and B-fiber ACCEPTs, and it omitted the preregistered independent generic size-five REJECT.
defects.cause: The plant helper selected the lexicographically first measured fiber and tested only the five-set formed by inserting a cell into it.
defects.impact: The exhaustive grids, matching sweeps, counts, ranks, and set equalities were unaffected, but the preregistered falsification battery was incomplete, so the pass could not be final.
defects.resolution: Added explicit A- and B-fiber ACCEPTs plus an exact rank-five generic five-set REJECT.

defects.stage: audit of the first correction while its rerun was in progress
defects.symptom: The rational-degree-two ACCEPT checked circuitness but did not exercise the degree-two fitter and had no explicit non-degree-two REJECT; the Möbius family had no named non-Möbius six-set REJECT.
defects.cause: The exhaustive set comparisons and generic wrong-curve control had been treated as sufficient, but the preregistration separately requires a known-true ACCEPT and a planted REJECT for every promoted positive family.
defects.impact: No parameter, census result, or theorem calculation was wrong. The superseded rerun had completed only the recorded prefix and was stopped before it could be mistaken for final evidence.
defects.resolution: Added a non-Möbius independent six-set REJECT, required the x=y^2 plant to pass the exact rational-degree-two fitter as well as circuitness, and added an x=y^3 non-fit/independence REJECT.

rerun_policy: After the final correction the entire preregistered computation matrix was rerun, not only the affected plant family.
